state.contract_text: This Agreement begins on November 1, 2024 (the "Effective Date") and continues for an initial term of twelve (12) months. Thereafter, this Agreement automatically renews for successive twelve (12)-month terms unless either party gives the other written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days before the end of the then-current term. Notice may be delivered by hand, by courier, or by email to the other party's designated contract contact.
state.cancellation_email_text: Hi team, per our contract we'd like to cancel our subscription and confirm we will not be renewing for another term. Please let us know if you need anything else from us. Thanks, Jordan

effective_date_year.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. What year is the Effective Date (the date this Agreement began) stated in `contract_text`?

criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not state an Effective Date

effective_date_month.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. What month is the Effective Date (the date this Agreement began) stated in `contract_text`?

criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not state an Effective Date

effective_date_day.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. What day of the month is the Effective Date (the date this Agreement began) stated in `contract_text`?

criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not state an Effective Date

term_length_months.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. What is the length, in months, of each term after which this Agreement automatically renews? Use the renewal term length if `contract_text` states it separately from the initial term length; otherwise use the initial term length.

criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not state a term length

required_notice_days.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. How many days of advance written notice does `contract_text` require before the end of the then-current term in order to prevent automatic renewal? If the contract states the period in months, convert to the nearest listed number of days (one month ≈ 30 days, two months ≈ 60 days, three months ≈ 90 days, six months ≈ 180 days).

criteria.0: no advance notice is required to prevent renewal
criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not state, or does not allow determining, a required notice period

notice_method_allows_email.instructions: Read `contract_text` only. Does `contract_text` permit a cancellation or non-renewal notice to be delivered by ordinary email?

criteria.yes: `contract_text` explicitly permits email as an acceptable delivery method for the notice, or does not restrict delivery method to something narrower than email
criteria.no: `contract_text` requires a delivery method that excludes ordinary email (e.g. certified mail only, a specific web portal only, in-person only)
criteria.unclear: `contract_text` does not address the permitted delivery method for the notice

notice_content_clear.instructions: Read `cancellation_email_text` only. Does the text clearly and unambiguously state the sender's intent to cancel the contract or not renew it for a further term?

criteria.true: `cancellation_email_text` clearly states intent to cancel or not renew
criteria.false: `cancellation_email_text` is ambiguous, conditional, or does not clearly state intent to cancel or not renew
